segments.text: Then Job answered and said,

verses.text: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

segments.text: How hast thou helped him that is without power!
How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

verses.text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!

segments.text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom,
And plentifully declared sound knowledge!

verses.text: To whom hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?

segments.text: To whom hast thou uttered words?
And whose spirit came forth from thee?

verses.text: They that are deceased tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

segments.text: They that are deceased tremble
Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.text: Sheol is naked before God, And Abaddon hath no covering.

segments.text: Sheol is naked before
God
And Abaddon hath no covering.

verses.text: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.

segments.text: He stretcheth out the north over empty space,
And hangeth the earth upon nothing.

verses.text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.

segments.text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds;
And the cloud is not rent under them.

verses.text: He incloseth the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.

segments.text: He incloseth the face of his throne,
And spreadeth his cloud upon it.

verses.text: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.

segments.text: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters,
Unto the confines of light and darkness.

verses.text: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at his rebuke.

segments.text: The pillars of heaven tremble
And are astonished at his rebuke.

verses.text: He stirreth up the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

segments.text: He stirreth up the sea with his power,
And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

verses.text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished; His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.

segments.text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished;
His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.

verses.text: Lo, these are but the outskirts of his ways: And how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?
